cart_owner_shape_check.name: cart_owner_shape_check
cart_owner_shape_check.value:
("cart"."customer_id" is not null and "cart"."guest_token_hash" is null and "cart"."expires_at" is null)
    or ("cart"."customer_id" is null and "cart"."guest_token_hash" is not null and "cart"."expires_at" is not null)

commerce_order_owner_shape_check.name: commerce_order_owner_shape_check
commerce_order_owner_shape_check.value:
("commerce_order"."customer_id" is not null
      and "commerce_order"."guest_access_token_hash" is null
      and "commerce_order"."guest_access_token_nonce" is null
      and "commerce_order"."guest_access_token_version" is null)
    or ("commerce_order"."customer_id" is null
      and "commerce_order"."guest_access_token_hash" is not null
      and "commerce_order"."guest_access_token_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
      and "commerce_order"."guest_access_token_nonce" is not null
      and length(btrim("commerce_order"."guest_access_token_nonce")) between 1 and 200
      and "commerce_order"."guest_access_token_version" is not null
      and "commerce_order"."guest_access_token_version" > 0)

commerce_order_money_safe_range_check.name: commerce_order_money_safe_range_check
commerce_order_money_safe_range_check.value:
"commerce_order"."subtotal_satang" between 0 and 9007199254740991
    and "commerce_order"."shipping_satang" between 0 and 9007199254740991
    and "commerce_order"."total_satang" between 0 and 9007199254740991

identity_email_claim_shape_check.name: identity_email_claim_shape_check
identity_email_claim_shape_check.value:
(
        "identity_email_claim"."state" in ('customer', 'staff')
        and "identity_email_claim"."user_id" is not null
        and "identity_email_claim"."invitation_id" is null
        and "identity_email_claim"."operation_id" is null
      ) or (
        "identity_email_claim"."state" = 'pending_staff'
        and "identity_email_claim"."user_id" is null
        and "identity_email_claim"."invitation_id" is not null
        and ("identity_email_claim"."operation_id" is null or "identity_email_claim"."request_id" is not null)
      ) or (
        "identity_email_claim"."state" = 'pending_customer'
        and "identity_email_claim"."user_id" is null
        and "identity_email_claim"."invitation_id" is null
        and "identity_email_claim"."operation_id" is not null
      )

order_event_status_values_check.name: order_event_status_values_check
order_event_status_values_check.value:
("order_event"."from_status" is null or "order_event"."from_status" in ('pending_payment', 'placed', 'processing', 'packed', 'shipped', 'delivered', 'cancelled'))
    and ("order_event"."to_status" is null or "order_event"."to_status" in ('pending_payment', 'placed', 'processing', 'packed', 'shipped', 'delivered', 'cancelled'))

order_event_actor_identity_check.name: order_event_actor_identity_check
order_event_actor_identity_check.value:
("order_event"."actor_type" = 'system' and "order_event"."actor_id" is null)
    or ("order_event"."actor_type" in ('customer', 'guest', 'staff')
      and "order_event"."actor_id" is not null
      and length(btrim("order_event"."actor_id")) between 1 and 200)

order_item_snapshot_text_check.name: order_item_snapshot_text_check
order_item_snapshot_text_check.value:
length(btrim("order_item"."sku")) between 1 and 120
    and length(btrim("order_item"."product_name")) between 1 and 300
    and length(btrim("order_item"."variant_name")) between 1 and 200
    and length(btrim("order_item"."unit")) between 1 and 80

order_item_allocation_restoration_state_.name: order_item_allocation_restoration_state_check
order_item_allocation_restoration_state_.value:
("order_item_allocation"."restoration_status" = 'restored' and "order_item_allocation"."restored_at" is not null)
    or ("order_item_allocation"."restoration_status" in ('reversible', 'released') and "order_item_allocation"."restored_at" is null)

order_outbox_claim_state_check.name: order_outbox_claim_state_check
order_outbox_claim_state_check.value:
("order_outbox"."status" = 'processing' and "order_outbox"."claimed_at" is not null)
    or ("order_outbox"."status" <> 'processing' and "order_outbox"."claimed_at" is null)

order_outbox_sent_state_check.name: order_outbox_sent_state_check
order_outbox_sent_state_check.value:
("order_outbox"."status" = 'sent' and "order_outbox"."sent_at" is not null)
    or ("order_outbox"."status" <> 'sent' and "order_outbox"."sent_at" is null)

staff_invitation_resolution_check.name: staff_invitation_resolution_check
staff_invitation_resolution_check.value: not ("staff_invitation"."accepted_at" is not null and "staff_invitation"."revoked_at" is not null)

stock_movement_type_delta_sign_check.name: stock_movement_type_delta_sign_check
stock_movement_type_delta_sign_check.value:
("stock_movement"."type" = 'receipt' and "stock_movement"."quantity_delta" > 0)
    or ("stock_movement"."type" in ('write_off', 'reservation_confirm') and "stock_movement"."quantity_delta" < 0)
    or ("stock_movement"."type" = 'order_cancel_restore' and "stock_movement"."quantity_delta" > 0)
    or "stock_movement"."type" = 'count_adjustment'

stripe_checkout_attempt_session_shape_ch.name: stripe_checkout_attempt_session_shape_check
stripe_checkout_attempt_session_shape_ch.value:
("stripe_checkout_attempt"."stripe_session_id" is null and "stripe_checkout_attempt"."checkout_url" is null)
    or ("stripe_checkout_attempt"."stripe_session_id" is not null and "stripe_checkout_attempt"."checkout_url" is not null and "stripe_checkout_attempt"."expires_at" is not null)

stripe_refund_actor_shape_check.name: stripe_refund_actor_shape_check
stripe_refund_actor_shape_check.value:
("stripe_refund"."request_actor_type" = 'staff' and "stripe_refund"."request_actor_id" is not null and length(btrim("stripe_refund"."request_actor_id")) between 1 and 200)
    or ("stripe_refund"."request_actor_type" = 'system' and "stripe_refund"."request_actor_id" is null)
